title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final ratio of intensities I'/I = 4.

title: Amplitude Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly calculate the resultant amplitude for the zone plate using the contributions from the odd half-period zones.

title: Intensity Relation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the relationship between amplitude and intensity for both the zone plate and the lens.

title: Comparison Justification
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain why the lens focuses more zones than the zone plate and how this affects intensity.

title: Units Check
description: Optional Criteria: The student should verify that units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as miscalculating the number of zones or the resultant amplitude.

title: Assumption Clarification
description: Optional Criteria: The student should clarify the assumptions made regarding the small diameter of the opening compared to distances.
